messages:
elaine: Heads-up — planning a phased migration of users_profiles (shard by id) TOMORROW at 02:00 UTC. Need owners for the migration job, smoke checks, and rollback plan. :calendar: 

mike: I can own the deploy step + run the migration job itself. what's the dual-write window you're thinking?

raj: I'll take the backfill monitoring and the post-migrate validation scripts. would like a 30m dual-write window to let KV caches warm and catch any replication lag.

ivy: I'll own the smoke tests in US and EU regions. quick checklist: sign-in, profile read/write, avatar upload, and a few heavy-list queries.

sam: I'll setup the alerting runbook and dashboards. I'll pre-create a grafana panel and a pager rule for error-rate > 1% sustained for 5m.

elaine: sounds good. mike, can you confirm the migration will be run in staged batches (shards 0-3, then 4-7)? want to avoid shard-sweep at once.

mike: yes, staged by shard, 15m per shard with 5m buffer. sequence: deploy migration container -> enable bi-directional writes for shard -> run per-shard backfill -> validate -> flip read traffic.

raj: validation steps I'll run: row-count diff, sample id checks, and run the smoke test suite against migrated shard. will post results.

elaine: rollback trigger conditions: any query error spike > 2% or backfill visibly stuck beyond 2x expected. In that case we abort remaining shards and switch to read-only for migrated shards.

ivy: do we have a fast rollback command?

mike: rollback plan: 1) disable bi-directional writes (feature-flag off), 2) switch reads to primary db for affected shards, 3) run tiny repair script if needed. quick command we use: `./deployctl feature-flag set users_profiles_biwrite false --env prod` and `./trafficctl route set users-read primary --shard X`.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: users-profiles-migration by mike at 2025-07-10T02:00:00Z (triggered). Watchers: raj, ivy, sam, elaine.

sam: I'll be on-call during the window and will coordinate with SRE if latency or errors spike. I've pre-warmed the canaries dashboard.

raj: also we'll run `SELECT count(*) FROM users_profiles WHERE migrated = true` and compare to `users` table as sanity check. I'll push a tiny report to the thread every 5m during the window.

elaine: network/infra checklist: ensure replica lag < 5s prior to each shard start. Mike, please verify replicas healthy 10m before window and post status.

mike: will do. plan: run `replica_check.sh` at 01:50 UTC and paste output here.

ivy: smoke test runbooks are in docs/qa/smoke/users_profiles.md — I'll link results, but quick note: the avatar S3 bucket permission step is required after migration, I'll validate that.

elaine: last item — post-migrate regression: we'll enable old-model fallback for 1 hour (traffic split 90/10) so if regressions appear we can kill new route quickly.

mike: noted. I'll create the canary traffic split and a fast rollback playbook in the runbook.

elaine: thanks all. final checklist reminders: backups taken at 01:30 UTC, replica check at 01:50, shard staging plan, smoke owners (ivy), monitoring (sam), rollback cmds (mike). Post your confirmations here. :thumbsup:

mike: confirmed. :thumbsup:

raj: confirmed. I'll post the first validation report after shard 0. :eyes:

ivy: confirmed, will run smoke tests and report. :white_check_mark:

sam: confirmed. on-call + dashboard ready. :iphone:

elaine: perfect — let's keep this thread as the coordination channel during the window. if anything critical arises, call SRE immediately and post to #incidents. good luck all. :rocket:
